media.title: Journey to America — document gallery
media.description: Document gallery for Kaper’s journey to America and early U.S. immigration record. Includes the Certificate of Arrival no. 23-46078, Declaration of Intention no. 74224, Border-crossing manifest from Calexico, and related contextual images.
media.altText: Gallery card for Bronisław Kaper’s journey to America, combining immigration and travel documents.
media.publicCaption: Gallery of immigration and travel documents relating to Bronisław Kaper’s journey to America, including arrival, declaration of intention and border-crossing records.
media.rightsNote: This gallery has no single rights status. Each member medium carries its own public-domain, licensed, restricted or unresolved-copyright statement; reuse must be assessed item by item.
media.publicCreditLine: Item-level credits identify the holding institution and source for every gallery member.
